text:
lucy: We're seeing a reproducible stall in the Python async SDK around token rotation. When our auth provider rotates keys we get a short spike of 401s and then many requests hang.
rahul: can you paste a tiny repro? sounds similar to earlier connpool problems but want specifics.
lucy: minimal repro attached (runs under uvloop + httpx):
```
# run repro
python examples/rotate_token_repro.py --workers 48 --rotate-after 8s
```
lucy: logs snippet: \n```
WARNING httpcore._backends.auto: Reusing closed transport (fd=34)\nERROR httpx._exceptions.ReadError: Unable to read from connection\nTask exception: ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer\n```
maria: rough theory: transport resets during auth failure path, but pool re-enqueues it because it wasn't marked explicitly bad. next request takes it and blocks.
ben: workaround we used locally: when token refresh happens, call `await client.aclose()` and recreate client. heavy but works.
rahul: is the AsyncRedwoodClient context manager typed properly? we've had cases where global clients hide misuse.
maria: good catch — AsyncRedwoodClient.__aenter__ currently annotated as Any in the SDK. that hides users storing clients as globals and never closing them. I'll open a typing PR to return the right type and encourage usage patterns.
lucy: tried lowering pool_limit and reducing keepalive and that reduced frequency but didn't eliminate. aclose() on rotation is reliable.
infra-bot: CI job queued: sdk/connpool-rotation-ci #93.
rahul: plan: 1) have pool mark transports as dead on ConnectionResetError or on 401/403 responses during request; 2) add `drop_on_auth_error=True` flag and default to true so auth-paths don't reuse broken transports; 3) tighten AsyncRedwoodClient typing so mypy warns for module-level clients.
maria: also propose adding a small helper `await client.drain_unhealthy()` that evicts suspected connections without closing the whole client. less disruptive.
ben: we should also emit metrics `connpool.evicted_on_auth` to correlate with token rotations.
lucy: opened issue #2523 with logs and repro gist: https://gist.github.com/lucy/rotate-repro. assigning to @maria for pool change and @ben for metrics. will test next week. :thumbsup:
